g.text: DIR. S. BELMIROHA · SCENE 12: THE CARGO HOLD · SCI-FI
Vessel 7 in profile. Dark. Hull breach to port. Shuttle approaches.
Symmetric framing. The hatch is the subject.
Cone of light reveals it. We see before she does.
Her face faint. The thing reflected, sharp.
Tilt up. Full height. She is small in the frame. So is the human story.
No music. No movement. Whatever happens next, it's earned.
SCENE 12 · 6 SHOTS · ESTABLISHING → INT REVEAL → POV → REACTION → FULL → STANDOFF · BUILDS DREAD VIA WITHHOLDING
